topic: Empirical Superiority of Rating Count over Bayesian Weighted Average (m=10) in Top-N
problem_statement: Compare empirical performance of unpersonalized POPULARITY_COUNT against POPULARITY_WEIGHTED (m=10.0) under full-catalog Leave-1-Last evaluation.
solution_or_decision: Evaluation on all 109,779 positive validation targets shows POPULARITY_COUNT achieves NDCG@10 = 0.02789 and HitRate@10 = 5.519%, outperforming POPULARITY_WEIGHTED at m=10.0 (NDCG@10 = 0.00771, HitRate@10 = 1.969%) by a factor of 3.62x in NDCG@10 and 2.80x in HitRate@10. This is an observed empirical measurement for m=10.0 and does not imply Count exceeds every possible m parameter.
evidence: Observed on 109,779 positive validation targets: Count HR@10=0.05519 vs Weighted(m=10) HR@10=0.01969 (ratio 2.80x). Count NDCG@10=0.02789 vs Weighted(m=10) NDCG@10=0.00771 (ratio 3.62x).
